reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it covers most of what I need; I don't see what these 'AI managers' do that copy-pasting doesn't, except cost me another 59 to 99 euros a month. I might poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay this week off a LinkedIn ad.
objection: Will it actually send the emails, follow up the leads and answer customers without me checking every line, or is it just drafts in a nicer wrapper? And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, I have no idea how far that goes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run one real job end to end on my own CRM and inbox during the free trial, like following up my leads for a week without me fixing the output, with a clear idea of what 100 credits actually buys.
